description: This PHP source file defines an abstract class 'PersonFormBase' that extends a form handling base class. It provides common functionality for handling duplicate detection and form rendering for person-related modules in SuiteCRM, such as lead or contact forms.

classes.name: PersonFormBase
classes.description: An abstract class providing shared form logic for person-related modules in SuiteCRM, including duplicate detection and form rendering.
